decisions.reason: The operator training programme builds on the firm's established training and application know-how, so the firm can interpret early results and improve it, making a drop unlikely.
The fourth rotary axis accessory builds on the firm's established machining equipment and accessory knowledge, enabling learning and improvement, so it is very unlikely to be dropped.

Hybrid additive post-processing is distant from the firm's established milling, dental, and dispensing knowledge, so the firm can hardly interpret early results or learn from them, making a drop likely.
The high-speed CNC milling machine is close to the firm's core established offer and has several models, so the firm can leverage related knowledge and is very unlikely to drop it.
The automatic tool change system builds on the firm's established machining and automation knowledge, so it can be assimilated and improved, making a drop very unlikely.
